additional_info.subject: RE: 0367656 - ID0367656-DC/Si-D/IE-[MP / S2 170003301] Charging session fails CRM:00658000638
additional_info.body:
Hi Saurav,
Actually, the customer is using Credit Card payments, in addition to App – but the way Payter Cloud operates means this will still work as the charger does not need to know about the terminal – a credit card payment is authorised by the OCPP back end by remote start transaction, so for the charger, it is exactly the same as an App (QR code) remote start.
We have many successful contactless terminal payments on this outlet – see picture.
This seems to be a problem with DC4 specifically, that after authorisation (by OCPP) the charger is not getting to the parameter discovery stage.
Can we discuss on Teams, then update the ticket later?
